portals.observation: City confirms that from 28 April 2022 statutory local land charge searches are only available through HMLR; city no longer provides that public service. CON29 enquiries remain an application workflow.

Privacy notice says HMLR serves the migrated register using information supplied by the council; city local role is limited to update/source-data custody for local charges, not cadastral parcel boundary publication.
Official index includes Portsmouth Local Land Charges dataset; statutory charge extent is not legal parcel cadastre geometry.

Official dataset page says INSPIRE Index Polygons are indicative extents/positions of registered freehold properties and offers downloads by local authority, including Portsmouth City Council. Page declares Open Government Licence and current dataset publication 2026-09-06.

coverageAssessment.claimedScope: HM Land Registry’s official INSPIRE Index Polygons download supplies a Portsmouth City Council local-authority ZIP. The GML contains 65,055 features; at the unchanged WUP point one full source polygon (INSPIREID 30222163) covers the point. The layer represents indicative extents/positions of registered freehold properties, not a complete legal cadastre. In a bounded 400 m × 400 m EPSG:27700 window, 112 complete geometries were valid and 29 pairs had positive-area overlaps above 0.01 m² (largest 194.723 m²); the WUP-covering feature itself overlaps another index polygon by 0.469 m². This is positive source geometry with a native-topology runtime hold, not evidence of no coverage.
coverageAssessment.verifiedOpenScope: Full HMLR INSPIRE index polygon verified at exact WUP point. Scope is registered freehold extent/location only; local 400 m geometry QA shows native overlaps, and no citywide completeness is claimed.

technicalBlocker: The INSPIRE local window contains 29 positive-area overlap pairs (>0.01 m²) among 112 full geometries, including a 0.469 m² overlap with the WUP-covering polygon. These source-native overlaps conflict with a non-overlapping parcel runtime model. Keep the full source features and hold runtime qualification; do not repair, clip or drop overlaps.
remainingUncertainty: Whether the HMLR index geometry can support the intended parcel runtime despite its indicative registered-freehold scope and source-native overlaps; unregistered property and leasehold extents are outside this dataset.
nextStep: Root review the full native sample and bounded topology report; if runtime requires mutually exclusive parcels, keep the source disabled or model the overlaps explicitly without modifying source geometry.
pointBasis: Exact unchanged UN WUP 2025 city point (latitude, longitude); not an administrative boundary or a cadastral result.
registryBasis: HM Land Registry’s public INSPIRE Index Polygons dataset publishes a Portsmouth City Council local-authority file for registered freehold-property extents. This is official local-authority scoped registry geometry but is only an indicative freehold index, not a complete cadastre or definitive legal boundary map.

runtimeAssessment.reason: Official indicative registered-freehold index polygons are public and the WUP locator is covered. Independent native EPSG:27700 audit of112 full polygons confirms29 overlap pairs (>0.01m²), including the point-covering polygon. These source extents cannot be admitted as exclusive ground parcels without altering the source or representing overlap explicitly.

rootReview.decision: Public geometry verified; runtime held for source-native overlapping index extents. This is runtime-model incompatibility, not an invalid-source or missing-data finding.
